title: The decoy hashes every body while the GitHub verifier skips the HMAC for a missing or malformed signature, so timing tells known integrations apart
resolution: The composition's GithubWebhookDecoy repeats the plugin's work per signature form: no HMAC for a missing or malformed signature, HMAC and constant-time comparison for a well-formed one; a test counts the crypto calls of known and unknown integrations.

title: PostgreSQL text columns reject a NUL and cannot keep an unpaired surrogate of an identifier that the port accepts
resolution: The identifiers are stored as bytea of their UTF-16LE code units with length and parity checks; an integration test records and decodes a NUL and unpaired surrogates exactly.

title: The plugin receipt test of a ping depends on the record of the preceding test
resolution: Each test builds its own plugin, receiver, and record, and the ping test asserts its own record stays empty.

title: The migration, plugin receipt, and access requirement tests have no recorded fail-before run
resolution: The record names negative-control runs for each migration constraint, the down migration, installation_repositories handling, and the operation's security, each failing and passing once restored.

title: The unauthenticated webhook route buffers up to 25 MiB per request with no concurrency bound and reads a body whose declared length is over the limit
resolution: Signed bodies run under their own slots, MAX_CONCURRENT_WEBHOOKS at once, the rest wait unread, and a declared length over 25 MiB answers 413 before any byte is read; two HTTP tests failed before the fix.

title: The design and the source control contract call the event header verified, although the signature covers only the body
resolution: The design and source control section 6.1 say that the signature covers the body only and that the headers are trusted as far as TLS and the secret keep signed bodies from others.

title: The SCM-neutral scm-port delta states the GitHub eventless events and a GitHub scenario
resolution: The scm-port delta names no SCM; the GitHub decoy and eventless events moved to a new control-plane-api requirement with the decoy and ping scenarios.

title: Wire contracts section 5 omits the identifier that is not valid percent-encoding from the identical 401
resolution: Section 5 lists an identifier that is not valid percent-encoding among the cases of the identical 401.

title: The route matcher keeps an undecodable path parameter whenever a route has a signed body limit, an unrelated property
resolution: A named route flag, keepsUndecodablePathParameters, set on receiveScmWebhook, replaces the body limit test; an API server test failed before it.

title: The API services declare the webhook receiver as an inline structural type instead of a named one
The composition copies the GitHub plugin's signature header, its form, and the eventless event names
resolution: Within the coordinator's decision; a plugin-provided decoy and eventless capability through the microkernel changes the plugin and its API, out of scope; the decoy test catches drift meanwhile.

title: The slot concurrency test relies on the order of two connections and a fixed 100 ms sleep, and checks verification rather than an unread body
resolution: The test waits on gates: the first delivery holds the only slot inside its record, the second is started only then and signals its admission, and the server's body reads are counted per delivery; no sleep remains.

title: The Environment paragraph and the Checks table name different Node.js versions for the pass 2 fix round's make verify run
resolution: Every make verify run used the pinned v24.22.1, as its log shows; the table row now says so, and the Environment paragraph names v24.22.0 only for the focused runs.

title: The composition still copies the GitHub plugin's signature header, its form, and the eventless event names
resolution: Restates pass 2 finding 7, which stays deferred: a plugin-provided decoy and eventless capability changes the plugin and its API, outside this change; the reviewer agreed.
